modeNote: 2026 results come from the CEC results file by locality supplied by the project owner on 31 Oct 2026 (expc.csv): all ballot boxes counted, 7,331,981 eligible, 5,716,673 votes incl. 451,988 double envelopes (78.0%). Results are not yet certified as final. Earlier builds used the 22:00 election-day turnout report; it is kept in data/raw/2026/ for reference but no longer used. When certified results are published, replace data/raw/2026/expc.csv, set mode to "official_final" and run `npm run build:data`.

results2022.label: 2022 results by locality (Knesset 25)
results2022.origin: Central Elections Committee, Knesset 25 final results by locality (expc.csv), supplied by the project owner
results2022.notes: Matches the official national totals: 6,788,804 eligible, 4,794,593 votes, 4,764,742 valid (70.63%).

results2022Boxes.label: 2022 results by ballot box (Knesset 25)
results2022Boxes.origin: Central Elections Committee, Knesset 25 final results by ballot box (expb.csv), supplied by the project owner
results2022Boxes.notes: Used only to cross-check the locality file.

results2026.label: 2026 results by locality (Knesset 26)
results2026.origin: Central Elections Committee, Knesset 26 results by locality (expc.csv), supplied by the project owner on 31 Oct 2026
results2026.notes: All 12,018 ballot boxes; eligible voters match the CEC roster exactly. Used for 2026 turnout and for the 2026 bloc balance (config/parties-2026.json). Not yet certified final.

roster2026.label: 2026 ballot-box roster
roster2026.origin: Central Elections Committee polling-station list for Knesset 26 (stations.xlsx), as mirrored by github.com/harelc/elections-vote-transfer (data/k26_cec/stations.xlsx); converted with scripts/geo/convert_roster.py
roster2026.notes: 12,018 boxes, 7,331,981 eligible voters. Used only to measure how much of each locality's electorate the 2026 data cover.

geometry.label: Locality boundaries
geometry.origin: Central Bureau of Statistics, statistical areas 2011 with 2019 demography (statisticalareas_demography2019.gdb, cbs.gov.il geo layers), dissolved by locality code with scripts/geo/build_geometry.py
geometry.notes: Polygons are the CBS statistical-area extents of each locality (built-up and attached land), not municipal jurisdiction. Localities founded or recoded after the layer was produced have no polygon.
